name: syok-code
description: Run Syok Code, the AI coding agent that uses your own Syok keys, inside the editor: chat, give it a task, ask about selected code, fix the problems in a file.

commands.title: Syok Code: Give it a task...
Syok Code: Ask about the selected code...
Syok Code: Fix the problems in this file
Syok Code: Install or update the command-line program

syokCode.path.description: Full path of the syok program. Leave empty to use the one the installer puts in the .syok folder of your home folder.

syokCode.mode.description: How much Syok Code may do without asking you: ask (asks before every change and command), accept-edits (edits freely, asks before commands), plan (plans first), auto (asks nothing).

syokCode.model.description: Model name to ask for. Leave empty for Syok's default.

syokCode.extraArguments.description: Extra words added to every syok start, for example ["--no-web"].
